title: text block props
description: Rich text in the Elabora Markdown subset, with an optional note in the margin (aside): beside the text on wide windows, after it, indented, on narrow ones.
x-ai-instructions: Short paragraphs, conversational 'you' (E6), no decorative anecdotes (E1). Keep a screen under about 250 words (E3). When the plan has a locked text, use textRef instead of copying it. aside: a margin note of one or two sentences (a word explained, a source, a nuance); the text must read without it.

markdown.description: Text content. Use markdown or textRef, not both.

textRef.description: Id of a validated text of the plan: the block shows the plan's wording, and rewording it writes the plan.

aside.description: A note in the margin: beside the text on wide windows, after it, indented, on narrow ones; read after the text by screen readers.
